question: A, B, E, F, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A sits to the immediate left of E. Only three people sit between E and Q when counted from the right of E. Only one person sits between B and P when counted from the right of B. F sits to the immediate right of B. How many people sit between R and E when counted from the left of R?
solution:
Given:

A, B, E, F, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

A sits to the immediate left of E. Only three people sit between E and Q when counted from the right of E.

Only one person sits between B and P when counted from the right of B. F sits to the immediate right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8861cad05b2bd75269c0ead63dc8b56d073ee6aed99b307d66b9f2e5744b6e15.png] 

Thus, **Four **people sit between R and E when counted from the left of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
